source:
# New 52-Week High Returns by VIX Regime
# Detects new 52-week highs, segments forward returns by VIX level
# VIX regimes: Low (<15), Medium (15-25), High (>25)

# --- Data ---
src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
ts = index().value

# VIX index (shared context — same for all assets)
vix_src = common_indices(ticker=ReferenceIndex.VIX)()
vix = ffill(vix_src.c)

# --- 52-Week High Detection ---
rolling_high_252 = max(period=252)(close)
prior_high = rolling_high_252 >> 1
is_new_high = close > prior_high

# --- VIX Regime Classification ---
# 1 = Low (<15), 2 = Medium (15-25), 3 = High (>25)
vix_regime = conditional_select(
    is_valid(vix) and vix < 15, 1.0,
    is_valid(vix) and vix < 25, 2.0,
    is_valid(vix), 3.0,
    2.0
)

# Regime label for bars (string for labeled mode)
vix_regime_label = conditional_select(
    is_valid(vix) and vix < 15, 1.0,
    is_valid(vix) and vix < 25, 2.0,
    is_valid(vix), 3.0,
    2.0
)

# --- Forward Returns (21 trading days ~ 1 month) ---
fwd_21d = forward_returns(period=21)(close)

# --- Filtered Series ---
# Post-new-high forward returns (sparse — only on new-high days)
nh_fwd_21d = where(is_new_high, fwd_21d)

# VIX regime on new-high days only (for labeled bar chart)
nh_regime = where(is_new_high, vix_regime_label)

# Year extraction for heatmap
year_num = datetime_extract(component=DatetimeExtractionType.year)(ts)
nh_year = where(is_new_high, year_num)

# VIX regime on new-high days for heatmap x-axis
nh_regime_for_hm = where(is_new_high, vix_regime)

# Count indicator: 1.0 on each new-high day for heatmap aggregation
nh_count_indicator = where(is_new_high, 1.0)

# VIX level on new-high day for event marker
nh_vix = where(is_new_high, vix)

# Regime text for event marker badge
nh_regime_text = conditional_select(
    is_new_high and is_valid(vix) and vix < 15, "Low VIX",
    is_new_high and is_valid(vix) and vix < 25, "Mid VIX",
    is_new_high and is_valid(vix), "High VIX",
    "N/A"
)

# --- Output 1: Histogram of Post-New-High Forward Returns ---
histogram(
    title='Do New Highs Lead to More Gains Over the Next Month?',
    category='New 52-Week High by VIX Regime',
    bins=30,
    show_analytics=True,
    fill_color=Color.Blue,
    fill_opacity=0.7,
    x_axis_label='21-Day Forward Return',
    x_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    x_axis_dp=1,
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=1
)(nh_fwd_21d)

# --- Output 2: Regime-Segmented Bars — Median Return by VIX Regime ---
xy_bars(
    mode=BarMode.labeled,
    agg=AggregationType.Median,
    title='Does VIX Regime Change Post-Breakout Momentum?',
    category='New 52-Week High by VIX Regime',
    data_labels=True,
    color_by_value=True,
    y_axis_format=AxisValueFormat.PercentFormat,
    y_axis_dp=2,
    y_axis_label='Median 21-Day Forward Return',
    x_axis_label='VIX Regime (1=Low <15, 2=Mid 15-25, 3=High >25)',
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=0.0, color=Color.Gray, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash, title='Zero')
    ]),
    order=2
)(values=nh_fwd_21d, label=nh_regime)

# --- Output 3: Heatmap — New-High Clustering by VIX Regime × Year ---
heatmap(
    agg=AggregationType.Sum,
    title='When Do New Highs Cluster? Regime x Year Count',
    category='New 52-Week High by VIX Regime',
    x_axis_label='VIX Regime (1=Low, 2=Mid, 3=High)',
    y_axis_label='Year',
    min_color=Color.White,
    max_color=Color.Blue,
    null_color=Color.Slate,
    show_data_labels=True,
    data_label_format='{point.value:.0f}',
    value_format=AxisValueFormat.IntegerFormat,
    order=3
)(x=nh_regime_for_hm, y=nh_year, value=nh_count_indicator)

# --- Event Markers — Each New 52-Week High with VIX Regime ---
event_marker(
    schema=EventMarkerSchema(
        title='New 52-Week High',
        icon=Icon.TrendingUpIcon,
        schemas=[
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Regime', type=CardRenderType.TextFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.PrimaryBadge),
            ColumnSpec(title='Close Price', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Hero),
            ColumnSpec(title='21d Fwd Return', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.PercentFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Subtitle),
            ColumnSpec(title='VIX Level', dp=1, type=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Footer),
            ColumnSpec(title='Prior 252d High', dp=2, type=CardRenderType.MonetaryFormat,
                       card_slot=CardSlot.Details),
            ColumnSpec(table_is_filter=True, table_visible=False)
        ]
    )
)(nh_regime_text, close, fwd_21d, vix, prior_high, is_new_high)
